boundaries: Fixture events only; no repository-wide root or liveness census.
Raw contexts repeat declarations and include intermediate environments; rows are not distinct root counts.
A null import owner can denote a current-module or temporary declaration; it does not mean unused.
Saved contexts sample environments; declarations absent from all saved contexts are not observed. Context IDs are traversal order, not creation chronology.
Explicit async-option setters are rejected before elaboration; macro-created setters remain outside completeness claims.
Exclusion is post-command name presence; same-name transient versions may be omitted. Imported owners are first-owner hints, not resolved winners.
Enabled async or pending snapshot/lazy tasks are rejected; this raw capture does not certify arbitrary command effects.
Guarded failures, extension effects and runtime name construction require separate treatment.
